turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm setting up my dev environment for the new project. I've been reading up on Matt Pocock's workflow for AI-assisted coding.
That's a solid choice. Pocock's approach is quite practical. What specific parts are you focusing on?
The model separation. I've decided to stick to his recommendation: Sonnet is used for implementation in Matt Pocock's AI workflow. I'll just use GPT-4 for the high-level planning.
Understood. Using Sonnet for the actual code generation and GPT-4 for architecture makes sense.
Yeah. Also, do you know if my SSD is still under warranty? I think I bought it in 2023.
I don't have access to your purchase records, but most SSDs have a 5-year warranty. Check your receipt or the manufacturer's site.
Right. I'll look it up. Thanks. I'm going to go grab some coffee, it's pouring rain here.
